title: Tightened initialization with variance penalty on 25-layer SiO2/Al2O3
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness initialization to ±8 nm around nominal quarter-wave optical thicknesses at 267.5 nm, combined with a soft penalty on variance of adjacent high-index layers, will reduce optimizer overshoot near resonant basin boundaries and improve target score convergence compared to the ±15-20% bounds used in prior iterations.
design_principle: Apply feedback-directed refinement: tighter initialization bounds dampen exploration noise, variance penalty suppresses spurious phase modulation between adjacent high-index layers, and reduced learning rate (50%) prevents oscillation near optima.
proposed_topology: 25 finite coating layers on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Alternating SiO2/Al2O3 stack with asymmetric cavity structure: [SiO2|Al2O3]_12 + central SiO2 cavity layer.
design_variables: layer thicknesses (bounded ±8 nm from quarter-wave nominal at 267.5 nm)
manufacturing_considerations: thickness tolerance ±8 nm achievable with ALD or IAD
theory_basis: Transfer Matrix Method for coherent multilayer interference
Quarter-wave stack theory for Bragg mirror design
Cavity resonance theory for bandpass filtering
expected_advantages: Faster convergence due to tighter initialization
Reduced risk of local minima trapping
More reproducible thickness profiles across candidates
known_risks: Overly tight bounds may prevent escape from suboptimal basins
Variance penalty may suppress beneficial asymmetry
execution_request_english: Optimize a 25-layer dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: alternating SiO2 and Al2O3 starting with SiO2, total 25 finite coating layers. Initialize thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness for 267.5 nm center wavelength (SiO2 ~45 nm, Al2O3 ~67 nm based on typical UV indices). Apply optimization bounds of ±8 nm from nominal for all layers. Include soft penalty term proportional to variance of adjacent Al2O3 layer thicknesses. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with learning rate reduced to 50% of default value. Evaluate coherent TMM transmission across three bands: 255-280 nm (maximize), 300-700 nm (minimize), 700-1100 nm (minimize). No metal layers permitted. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance in 255–280 nm; low transmittance in 300–700 nm; low transmittance in 700–1100 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 300–700 nm; transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30; no metal layers; conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials only.
revision_reason: Direct response to feedback directives: tighten initialization bounds to ±8 nm, add variance penalty on adjacent high-index layers, reduce learning rate by 50% to dampen overshoot.
